q: I have a claim dated in 2025 and I am not sure which version of the overtime rate applies to it. Where is that written down?
log:
A claim dated in 2025 falls in the window 2024-07-01 to 2025-12-31, so the applicable overtime rate version is `hard-overtime-v2` in the attendance area. Let me read it to confirm.

READ hard-overtime-v2

DONE

For a claim dated in 2025, the applicable overtime rate rule is written down in the **attendance** area:

1. **`hard-overtime-legend-revision`** (attendance) — this is the index/legend explaining that overtime rate has three versions over time, and that for a 2025-dated question you must use the *middle* version, not the oldest and not the current one.

2. **`hard-overtime-v2`** (attendance) — this is the actual rule text, in force from 2024-07-01 to 2025-12-31, giving the multiplier table indexed by day and hours. This is the version that applies to your 2025 claim.

(Note: the payroll area also has an old overtime page, `payslip-overtime`, but a `hard-moved-overtime` warning there confirms it only applies before 2024-07-01 and is not relevant to a 2025 date — the current authority for 2025 is `hard-overtime-v2` in attendance.)
